Inspirisys Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Inspirisys Solutions Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 11,699 lakhs for the quarter and 22,123 lakhs for the six-month period. Profit after tax was 500 lakhs for the quarter and 1,301 lakhs for the six-month period. Earnings per share were 1.26 for the quarter and 1.78 for the six-month period. The Board approved the re-appointment of Mr. Noriyuki Okayasu as Senior Advisor for a one-year term starting April 1, 2027, subject to immigration formalities. The limited review report by MSKA & Associates LLP indicated no material misstatements in the financial results.

voiceSummary: Inspirisys Solutions Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue was 11,699 lakhs for the quarter and 22,123 lakhs for the six months. Profit after tax was 500 lakhs for the quarter and 421 lakhs for the six months. Earnings per share were 1.26 for the quarter and 1.78 for the six months. The Board approved the re-appointment of Mr. Noriyuki Okayasu as Senior Advisor for a one-year term starting April 1, 2027. This appointment is subject to completion of immigration formalities. The limited review report from statutory auditors MS KA & Associates LLP was attached. The Board meeting concluded at 4.15 PM on November 11, 2026.
